title: The Amazing Digital Circus
titleNative: アメイジングデジタルサーカス
synopsis: These cute, cartoony characters hate their lives and just want to escape! An official adaptation of The Amazing Digital Circus animated series. Transformed into a cartoon jester named Pomni, she discovers she’s trapped in this glitchy digital world alongside a whole host of colorful characters. Will she be able to find the exit door and escape, or will she be stuck here until she loses her mind? (Source: VIZ Media)

However, there is someone who falls in love with her at first sight after seeing her kindness! It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan. "I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!" She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is... After hearing the heart-fluttering words that she doesn't know anything about you and wants to get to know you more, she eventually runs away. A heart-fluttering story of a super popular hero and an unpopular magical girl who accepts his confession. (Source: Peanutoon, translated)
